verdict.rationale: Teller documents that its balances API returns live, real-time balances, and markets 'guaranteed live account balances.' A balances API call therefore effectively yields now-fresh data on demand. However, there is no evidence of an explicit refresh-trigger endpoint, and no documented refresh semantics for transactions or other data. Missing for 10: an explicit on-demand refresh endpoint, documented refresh semantics (timing, rate limits, completion signaling), live-fetch guarantees for transactions and other resources, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
